transcribed_question: Name the boundaries of the Anatomical Snuffbox.
main_question: Name the boundaries of the Anatomical Snuffbox.
main_answer: Anterior/lateral boundary: tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis. Posterior/medial boundary: tendon of extensor pollicis longus. Floor: scaphoid and trapezium bones.
main_explanation: The anatomical snuffbox is a triangular depression on the radial (lateral) aspect of the hand at the level of the carpal bones.
